attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Placeholder NJ military retirement exclusion. NJ exempts military pensions per N.J.S.A. 54A:6-26. Full implementation accumulates per-taxpayer military pension income; the current simplification sets the exclusion to 0 unless populated by per-income iteration in a follow-up sub-table.

New Jersey state income tax dispatcher per Form NJ-1040 / N.J.S.A. 54A. Computes NJ gross income (federal AGI as a conservative simplification), exemptions ($1,000 per taxpayer + $1,500 per dependent), taxable income, then dispatches to a bracket sub-table based on filing status.

initial_action.initial_action_postfix: "NEW JERSEY FORM NJ-1040 - State Income Tax Calculation" job.audit_trail swap addto 0 /result.nj_tax xdef 0 /result.nj_exemption_total xdef 0 /result.nj_taxable_income xdef result.agi /result.nj_agi xdef " Starting Federal AGI: $" result.agi cvs strconcat " (Form 1040 Line 11)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto job.taxpayers length nj_personal_exemption f* job.dependents length nj_dependent_exemption f* f+ /result.nj_exemption_total xdef " Exemptions ($1,000/taxpayer + $1,500/dependent): $" result.nj_exemption_total cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.nj_agi result.nj_exemption_total f- 0 fmax /result.nj_taxable_income xdef " NJ Taxable Income: $" result.nj_taxable_income cvs strconcat " (NJ Gross - Exemptions)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Joint filers use the joint bracket schedule
condition_details.condition_dsl: job.filing_status is equal to "married_filing_jointly" OR job.filing_status is equal to "MFJ"

action_details.action_comment: MFJ -- apply joint bracket schedule via NJ_Tax_MFJ_Brackets
action_details.action_postfix: /NJ_Tax_MFJ_Brackets performtable " New Jersey Tax: $" result.nj_tax cvs strconcat " (Form NJ-1040 Line 42, MFJ brackets)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Single / HOH / MFS -- apply single bracket schedule via NJ_Tax_Single_Brackets
action_details.action_postfix: /NJ_Tax_Single_Brackets performtable " New Jersey Tax: $" result.nj_tax cvs strconcat " (Form NJ-1040 Line 42, Single brackets)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
